topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I didn't realize how much you were looking forward to it, or I might have fought harder to keep the surprise party going. It was supposed to be a light-hearted thing, a moment of joy pulled out of the ordinary. Now, it’s just another thing that didn’t quite come together. I wish I could turn back the time and make it right, but all I can do now is tell you how sorry I am. Maybe we can still find a way to celebrate, just you and me, without the fuss, without the disappointment. Just a quiet evening, remembering why we needed something like this in the first place.
